summary: Iteration 2 verification: preview-blank bug is FIXED. React frontend (dark Swiss Brutalism theme) renders correctly at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 4 panels (Chat, Documents, Eval, History) work end-to-end with real integrations: OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini via Emergent proxy returned a grounded answer '7 years from creation [2]', citation markers rendered, 5 retrieved chunks displayed, Langfuse trace link present, and RAGAS metric cards show real 0-1 floats (F=0.77, AR=0.54, CP=1.00) with trend chart plotting 3 historical runs. Sidebar shows live health stats (15 vectors, 4 docs, 12 queries, 384 dim, langfuse connected). No console errors, no CORS issues.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPanel.jsx line 127 and HistoryPanel.jsx line 76: `langfuse-trace-link` href uses REACT_APP_LANGFUSE_URL || 'https://us.cloud.langfuse.com' but does NOT append the trace_id path (e.g. /trace/<id>). User is dropped on Langfuse home page instead of the specific trace. Consider `${base}/project/<id>/traces/${result.trace_id}` or at minimum `${base}?traceId=${result.trace_id}` so the link actually opens the traced run.

CitedText.jsx regex `/\[chunk\s+([\d,\s]+)\]/gi` only matches the literal pattern `[chunk N]`. In one observed answer the model returned `[2]` (bare) instead of `[chunk 2]`, so the citation marker was still rendered because the model complied on that query, but this is fragile — if the model regresses to `[2]` style, no clickable citations will appear. Consider also matching `\[(\d+(?:,\s*\d+)*)\]` as a fallback or strengthen the system prompt to always emit `[chunk N]`.

Sidebar StatRow rows (vectors, documents, queries, pinecone dim) do not have data-testid attributes even though the review request lists them as testids. They are only findable by label text. Non-blocking (values are visible & correct in the DOM) but worth adding data-testid='stat-vectors' etc. for testability.
seed_data_creation: None. 4 seed docs and 8-item testset already present from iteration 1. One additional query added to history via test flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is now React (not Streamlit) at port 3000 via craco. All UI panels use shadcn components. Query-input is a plain Textarea (no Ctrl+Enter workaround needed like in iteration 1). Citation markers rely on the LLM producing `[chunk N]` literal — the regex in CitedText.jsx is strict. Backend endpoints unchanged from iteration 1. Langfuse trace link href is currently just the base host (no traceId in URL) — flagged in critical_code_review_comments.
rca_of_the_issue: Preview-blank bug root cause: Streamlit's iframe/WebSocket handshake was blocked in the preview environment, resulting in a blank page. Fix (already applied by main agent): replaced the Streamlit frontend with a standalone React SPA served from port 3000 that talks to the FastAPI backend via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified: page loads, sidebar visible with 'rag/eval' brand and live stats, all 4 panels navigate and render real data.
